verdict.rationale: Stagehand's documentation covers imperative browser automation primitives (act, extract, observe, agent), caching and self-healing selectors, but nothing about user-defined rules that fire actions automatically when events occur. selfHeal and agent fallbacks are adjacent recovery behaviors inside a running script, not configurable event-triggered rules. Developers could build triggers in their own code, but that is a building block, not the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
